name: OpenClaw llms.txt 清单校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# llms.txt 清单校验 Capsule
# 验证模型清单标题、支持模型定位与厂商/标识/API 兼容分类

echo "🔍 抓取模型清单..."
curl -s -o llms.txt https://docs.openclaw.ai/llms.txt

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证文档标题..."
grep -q "LLMs.txt" llms.txt && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证厂商列表入口..."
grep -q "Model Providers" llms.txt && echo "provider ok" || echo "provider fail"

# 清理
rm -f llms.txt
description: 验证 llms.txt 标题、支持模型定位与厂商/标识/API 兼容分类
